package __PACKAGE__;

// Verifies the signed session tokens issued by this project's identity service. Generated by Tessery.

import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.Base64;
import javax.crypto.Mac;
import javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec;

public record Session(String sub, String email, String role, long exp) {
    private static final byte[] SECRET = System.getenv().getOrDefault("AUTH_SECRET", "").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    private static final ObjectMapper JSON = new ObjectMapper();

    public static Session verify(String token) {
        if (token == null || SECRET.length == 0) return null;
        String[] parts = token.split("\\.");
        if (parts.length != 3) return null;
        try {
            Mac mac = Mac.getInstance("HmacSHA256");
            mac.init(new SecretKeySpec(SECRET, "HmacSHA256"));
            byte[] want = mac.doFinal((parts[0] + "." + parts[1]).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            if (!MessageDigest.isEqual(want, Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(parts[2]))) return null;
            JsonNode body = JSON.readTree(Base64.getUrlDecoder().decode(parts[1]));
            long exp = body.path("exp").asLong(0);
            if (exp < System.currentTimeMillis() / 1000) return null;
            return new Session(body.path("sub").asText(""), body.path("email").asText(""), body.path("role").asText(""), exp);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    /** Reads `Authorization: Bearer ...` or the `session` cookie from the raw header values. */
    public static Session from(String authorization, String cookieHeader) {
        if (authorization != null && authorization.startsWith("Bearer ")) return verify(authorization.substring(7));
        if (cookieHeader != null) {
            for (String part : cookieHeader.split(";")) {
                String p = part.trim();
                if (p.startsWith("session=")) return verify(p.substring(8));
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
